items.title: Auto-run Codex as an independent reviewer over the bound change and capture a structured materialHash-bound verdict
items.context: Reuse dispatch_prepare and the bounded Codex spawn primitive (runBoundedCodexProvider / runCodexRealLeafDispatch); extend checkDispatchPolicy to sanction a bounded Codex real-leaf for REVIEW only. Capture ONLY structured verdict fields (decision plus findings); do NOT promote raw stdout transcript into evidence (respect the credential-safety boundary in codex-cli.ts). Feed the verdict into the existing submitLocalVerdict / autopilot_review_submit path so it binds to the exact materialHash. No cryptographic signing.

happy.desc: Injected fake Codex seam returns stdout carrying a valid JSON fail verdict (schema lattice.codex_review_verdict.v1, decision=fail, materialHash=currentMaterialHash). Assert: host-B verdict is recorded with decision===fail AND materialDigest===currentMaterialHash(root), confirming the capture path binds to the exact code.
registry.get(cross_host_review) is defined after handler registration, proving the command is registered in the catalog and registry.

edge.desc: Fail-closed on unparseable output: fake Codex seam returns garbage stdout (no JSON). Assert: host-B verdict decision===blocked, reason includes codex_review_no_parseable_verdict, result exposes stdoutDigest but no raw-stdout field (credential-safety boundary).
Fail-closed on schema mismatch: fake seam returns valid JSON but missing required fields (e.g. no decision field). Assert: decision===blocked, reason codex_review_no_parseable_verdict.

Rebinding guard: fake Codex seam returns a structurally valid verdict whose materialHash differs from the orchestrator-computed digest. Assert: decision===blocked, reason mentions materialHash mismatch.
Codex process exits non-zero (seam simulates crash or timeout). Assert: decision===blocked, stdoutDigest present, no raw stdout promoted.

adversarial.desc: Raw stdout injection: fake Codex seam returns stdout containing both a valid verdict JSON block AND malicious text outside it (e.g. fake credentials, prompt-injection attempts). Assert: only the structured JSON verdict fields are parsed and recorded; no raw stdout text appears in the recorded verdict or evidence.

Dispatch-policy bypass: attempt to run a codex implementation subprocess (not review-only) through the new allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess flag. Assert: checkDispatchPolicy still refuses non-review codex/gemini/antigravity implementation calls even when the review-only flag is set.

Mutually-exclusive dispatch flags: a dispatch policy carrying BOTH allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess=true AND allowRealHostSubprocess=true with allowedHosts=['codex'] is REFUSED by checkDispatchPolicy (the two flags are mutually exclusive for codex, so it can never reach the implementation dispatch path); a PURE review-only codex policy is still permitted.
Missing policy fails closed: calling cross_host_review with NO policy fails closed -- authorizeReviewPolicy throws, the codex seam is never invoked, and zero verdicts are recorded.
Unauthorized policy fails closed: a policy that does not grant a read-only codex reviewer (unauthorized) fails closed the same way (throw, seam never invoked).

Policy constraints threaded to runner: the authorized policy's env denylist + secret-pattern strip + max-runtime timeout ceiling are actually threaded to the codex spawn (asserted via a capturing seam that records the RunCodexReviewLeafOptions: timeoutMs === policy ceiling, denied/secret env names absent).

Dirty-worktree integrity fail-closed: cross_host_review binds the verdict to currentMaterialHash(HEAD) (committed tree) but Codex reviews the LIVE worktree. When the worktree has uncommitted MATERIAL (source) drift vs HEAD (excluding .lattice/ metadata), the handler MUST fail closed (throw cross_host_review_dirty_worktree, no codex spawn, no verdict recorded) so a HEAD-bound verdict can never reflect a review of a dirty tree. Control: a worktree dirty only in .lattice/ proceeds normally.

Malformed host-A findings input fails closed: the hostAFindingsFile (caller-supplied JSON) is strictly validated as Finding[] (strict Zod — no missing/extra/wrong-typed keys, must be an array). A malformed host-A findings file (missing a required Finding field, extra keys, or non-array) causes cross_host_review to fail closed (reject) rather than trusting unvalidated JSON.parse output — hardening the host-A trust boundary alongside the strict codex-verdict schema and runtime policy-shape validation.

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke check "CHK-001:happy:0": fake FAIL verdict -> recorded host-B decision===fail and materialDigest===currentMaterialHash (capture path binds to exact code).
Smoke check "CHK-001:happy:1": registry.get(cross_host_review) is defined (command registered).
Smoke check "CHK-001:edge:0": garbage stdout -> blocked, reason codex_review_no_parseable_verdict, no raw-stdout field.
Smoke check "CHK-001:edge:1": valid JSON missing decision field -> blocked, no_parseable_verdict.
Smoke check "CHK-001:edge:2": wrong materialHash -> blocked (material mismatch / rebinding guard).
Smoke check "CHK-001:edge:3": non-zero exit + timeout, no verdict -> blocked, stdoutDigest present, no raw stdout.
Smoke check "CHK-001:adversarial:0": verdict JSON + malicious out-of-band text -> only structured fields parsed; malicious raw text absent from recorded verdict.
Smoke check "CHK-001:adversarial:1": checkDispatchPolicy still refuses non-review codex impl subprocess, and gemini/antigravity under the review-only flag.

Smoke "CHK-001:adversarial:2": a policy with BOTH allowReviewOnlyRealHostSubprocess AND allowRealHostSubprocess + allowedHosts=[codex] is REFUSED by checkDispatchPolicy; a pure review-only codex policy is permitted (F-003 mutual-exclusion).
Smoke "CHK-001:adversarial:3": cross_host_review with NO policy fails closed — authorizeReviewPolicy throws, codex seam never invoked, 0 verdicts recorded (F-004).
Smoke "CHK-001:adversarial:4": an unauthorized policy (no read-only codex grant) fails closed the same way — throw, seam never invoked (F-004).

Smoke "CHK-001:adversarial:5": authorized policy env denylist + secret-strip + max-runtime timeout ceiling threaded to the codex spawn, asserted via a capturing seam recording RunCodexReviewLeafOptions (F-004/F-007).

Build passed and cross_host_review smoke passed 24/24 after source commit 0170731fb. CHK-001:adversarial:6 now covers dirty source drift, pre-hash/post-spawn clean HEAD drift, and F-016 final-record post-write clean HEAD drift: the handler deletes the just-written host verdict pair and leaves no stale or partial verdict files for the drifted runId.

Smoke "CHK-001:adversarial:7": malformed host-A findings file (missing/extra/wrong-typed keys or non-array) -> cross_host_review fails closed via strict Zod Finding[] validation, not trusting raw JSON.parse. RED-verified.

items.title: Combine host-A and host-B verdicts into a joint decision that explicitly surfaces disagreements
items.context: New logic that diffs the two hosts findings and reports where they diverge (a finding raised by one host and not the other), instead of only a pass/fail union. This is the adversarial-value output. Bind to the same materialHash.

happy.desc: Injected fake Codex seam returns a fail verdict carrying one finding NOT in host-A findings. Assert: result.jointDecision.jointDecision===blocked, result.disagreement.onlyHostB.length===1, result.disagreement.hasDisagreement===true. Proves single-host findings cause fail-closed blocking.
Agreeing case: both hosts pass with identical findings (or both empty). Assert: jointDecision===pass, hasDisagreement===false, divergentCount===0. Proves the pass-through path works when hosts agree.

edge.desc: Host-A has a finding that host-B does not. Assert: onlyHostA.length>=1, hasDisagreement===true, jointDecision===blocked. Proves disagreement detection is symmetric (not just host-B-only).

One host passes and the other fails (no overlapping findings). Assert: jointDecision===blocked, blockedReason present, both hostADecision and hostBDecision accurately reflect their individual decisions.

Finding key normalization: two findings with same file:line but differently-cased titles (e.g. Foo Bar vs foo bar) are treated as the SAME finding (not a disagreement). Assert: they appear in agreed, not onlyHostA/onlyHostB.
Both hosts fail with identical findings. Assert: jointDecision===blocked (both non-pass), hasDisagreement===false (no finding-level divergence), agreed array contains the shared findings.
Host-B verdict is blocked (e.g. from CHK-001 fail-closed). Assert: jointDecision===blocked, blockedReason indicates host-B was blocked. Proves blocked propagates through the joint decision.

adversarial.desc: Cross-host materialHash mismatch: host-A and host-B verdicts reference different materialHash values. Assert: jointDecision===blocked. The joint decision must never pass when the two hosts reviewed different code states.

Duplicate finding injection: host-B returns the same finding twice (duplicate key). Assert: diffFindings deduplicates correctly and does not double-count as multiple disagreements or inflate the agreed set.
Reconstructed from logic_test evidence: Smoke check CHK-002:adversarial:2: identical hostA/hostB identity is rejected before Codex spawn, and no verdict is recorded, preserving ...

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke check "CHK-002:happy:0": host-B-only finding -> jointDecision blocked, onlyHostB.length===1, hasDisagreement true.
Smoke check "CHK-002:happy:1": identical findings both pass -> jointDecision pass, hasDisagreement false, divergentCount 0.
Smoke check "CHK-002:edge:0": host-A-only finding -> onlyHostA>=1, hasDisagreement true, blocked (symmetric detection).
Smoke check "CHK-002:edge:1": one pass / one fail no overlap -> blocked, blockedReason present, decisions accurate.
Smoke check "CHK-002:edge:2": same file:line differently-cased titles -> treated as SAME (agreed, not only*).
Smoke check "CHK-002:edge:3": both fail identical findings -> blocked, hasDisagreement false, agreed contains shared findings.
Smoke check "CHK-002:edge:4": host-B verdict blocked -> jointDecision blocked (blocked propagation).
Smoke check "CHK-002:adversarial:0": divergent host-A/host-B materialHash -> jointDecision blocked (never pass on divergent code states).
Smoke check "CHK-002:adversarial:1": host-B returns same finding twice -> diffFindings dedups, counts correct.
Smoke check CHK-002:adversarial:2: identical hostA/hostB identity is rejected before Codex spawn, and no verdict is recorded, preserving independent cross-host proof semantics.
